_comment: Allowlist for test/package-deps.mjs. Each key is an identifier used in the shipped m-trees (statistics-forge / data-smoothing-forge / symbolic-sympy) that `which` could not resolve against the real wasm build at audit time. Reasons: LOCAL = false positive (variable/subfunction/struct-field use that static extraction can't classify); CORE-MISSING = legit octave core function absent from this build; REAL-CROSS = genuine dependency outside the shipped trees (the gate's main quarry); BRIDGE = resolved by the symbolic Python bridge, not octave. Regenerate drafts: node package-deps.mjs --update-allowlist

stdnormal_cdf.reason: CORE-MISSING: octave stdnormal_cdf not in this build; dist_fun falls back to own implementation — verify call sites

srtcat.reason: REAL: looks like typo of strcat in bartlett_test/levene_test (package bug — confirm harmless)

sympify.reason: BRIDGE: python-side sympify helper, resolved via wasm-python bridge

stdnormal_pdf.reason: CORE-MISSING: octave stdnormal_pdf not in this build — verify call sites in jsupdf

nelder_mead_min.reason: REAL-CROSS-FIXED: regdatasmooth.m default-optimizer dep. Dockerfile now ships pure-.m nelder_mead_min into the baked data-smoothing-forge tree; verified in-browser (which resolves, default GCV path returns 101 finite pts). Entry stays until the next octave-wasm rebuild publishes the file (then reclassifies BAKED and can be dropped).

integrate.reason: REAL-CROSS: @sym/integrate method, not baked in the symbolic subset

inverse_laplace_transform.reason: REAL-CROSS: symbolic inverse_laplace_transform helper, not baked in the subset

inverse_fourier_transform.reason: REAL-CROSS: symbolic inverse_fourier_transform helper, not baked in the subset

_oo_dsolve.reason: BRIDGE: private python-side dsolve bridge symbol (oo_pyexpr), resolved via wasm-python
